wish: someone should make a tool that views files as hex
spec:
Opens any local file (or pasted text) and shows offsets, hex bytes and ASCII side by side, scrolling smoothly through large files.
Jump to an offset in hex or decimal, search for text or hex byte sequences, tap a byte to see its value in hex, decimal and binary.
It only reads: no editing, no saving, and the file never leaves the device.
notes: Whole file is read into memory with File.arrayBuffer; rows are virtualized so large files scroll without lag.
